issues.display_title: Issue #497: Add Country and City to User Detail
issues.main_description_html:
RESULT 11/08/26

✅ Implementation: Add Country and City to User Detail

Route

GET /v1/user/detail
Authorization: <JWT token>

Changes

  • Extended the existing non-v0 profile query to select country and city from users.
  • Added both fields to the default user detail result.
  • Added city to the allowed include fields; existing country filtering now receives its value from the profile query.
  • Added city handling to the filtered response builder.
  • Left the v0 branch and Redis user detail cache unchanged.

Data Flow

  1. Load cached base user data through UserDatas.
  2. Query country, city, cover_image, and website from users by user ID.
  3. Merge the profile values into the non-v0 result.
  4. Return all fields, or only valid fields requested through include.

Verification

gofmt -w src/Action/V1/Users/UserDetail.go
go test ./src/Action/V1/Users ./src/Utils/Functions/UserFunctions
git diff --check

The targeted Go packages compile successfully. The full go test ./... command exceeded the 120-second verification timeout.

Endpoint

GET /v1/user/detail

Scope

  • Return country and city from the users table in the non-v0 user detail response.
  • Support country and city in the include query parameter.
  • Keep the v0 response unchanged.
  • Keep the Redis user detail cache unchanged.

Request

Full response:

GET /v1/user/detail

Filtered response:

GET /v1/user/detail?include=country,city

Response Fields

{
  "country": "Indonesia",
  "city": "Jakarta"
}

Both fields may be null when no value is stored.
